capabilities: Open or create a day's daily note from a calendar click
Append timestamped entries to today's diary note via a quick-input box
Show writing statistics, streaks and a GitHub-style yearly heatmap
Highlight days whose notes match user-defined regex rules with colored dots
Render a timeline of today's timestamped entries grouped by time segment
extras: The README states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation requires building from source or using BRAT, and the UI supports English and Chinese.
intentEvidence: By default Better Calendar follows the core Daily notes plugin
problem: Obsidian's core calendar/daily-notes workflow has no compact calendar that also surfaces writing statistics, an activity heatmap and fast append-to-today capture in one pane.

relations.evidence: Reads your core Daily notes settings (folder, date format, template)

summary: Sidebar calendar pane that opens or creates daily notes from a template and adds a diary dashboard with quick input, statistics, a yearly heatmap and a timeline.
